verdict.rationale: Gunderson Dettmer runs client-facing platforms that hold client data (GDHQ corporate records, D&O portal, Catalyze), so asking about data retention and deletion controls is fair, but no evidence documents any user-controllable retention or deletion settings. The secure Azure-hosted ChatGD instance is an internal attorney tool, and the data-privacy legal practice is an advisory service, not a product control. Neither counts toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
